_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED example records — no dispatch contract exists (see lib/api-client/dispatch.ts)
brief: Captain checklist (2026-09-19): the Vehicle dispatch screen (/staff/dispatch) was a twelve-line stub; it is now the fleet, its drivers and the recorded day's trips.

Domain wording follows docs/04-modules/facilities-scheduling.md §14 (vehicle ID · plate · type · capacity · driver · availability · maintenance; trip pickup location/destination/date-time; dispatch workflow request → assign → dispatch → complete) and the Operations board's day (blueprint §36: today's vehicle dispatches).
note: WHAT THIS IS: the office's own recorded dispatch sheet — the fleet, the drivers on duty and the trips tied to cases — as the staff board shows it today. Vehicle dispatch belongs to D5 scheduling-resources (docs/02-architecture/microservices.md:51, the `dispatch.completed` event), which is unbuilt: no dispatch contract exists, so live mode answers 503 and only fixture mode serves these records (lib/api-client/dispatch.ts).

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/dispatch.test.ts): every trip's `case_number` is a case in lib/fixtures/operations/cases.json; every driver's `employee_number` and name are an HR directory employee (lib/fixtures/hr/employees.json); `veh-hearse-1` is the scheduling fixture's Hearse 1 resource (lib/fixtures/scheduling/resources.json, id 10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c4). The other vehicles are recorded before a scheduling resource exists for them and carry `resource_id: null` — the day board is not a scheduling booking.
DEMO DATA ONLY: plates, routes and times are example values. No amount (fare, rate, fuel) may ever be added here — a trip is a movement of a vehicle, not a sale.
A trip's day is the park's own calendar day (Asia/Manila) of `starts_at`, not a stored field; `as_of` is the day the board was recorded and the day it opens on.
CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo records are REMOVED. The office's reference data is kept; a record is written only when the office actually records one.
